rules.check: The audience, channel, one core message and intended viewer action are explicit; claims match actual supported product behavior.
Product revision, real assets, licensing, proportions and source-to-output decisions are traceable; illustrative collaboration is described truthfully.
Type weight, size, spacing and rendering preserve brand and reading without default heavy titles or decorative font combinations.
Necessary accurate copy, grouping, primary action and readable hold times replace redundant labels, jargon and repeated explanation.
Small viewing size, channel crop, perspective, occlusion and boundaries preserve important information without unwanted stretching or clipping.
Every movement has an information or interaction purpose; the interface settles for reading and clicking after the approved camera introduction.
The adopted product's real motion, image count, density, aspect ratio and near/far relationship are retained; arbitrary floating is not substituted.
Glass retains the approved transparency/refraction, readable foreground and restrained boundaries, with no unapproved white glow or layered decoration.
Each cursor has a distinct task and real target, remains understandable in parallel, and avoids arbitrary empty-space journeys or obscuring key copy.
Asset placement, typing, clicks, drag/release, selection and feedback correspond in both position and time; text is actually revealed character by character.
Camera return, theme and complete-language transitions are triggered coherently, remain legible and preserve expected control/content states.
Full audible playback confirms the agreed sound ownership, synchronized effects, controlled levels, clean joins and ending; metadata does not prove absence of voice/music.
The cover matches the video's product message; generated text, logos, geometry and repeated elements are inspected when present.
Complete decode, real duration, dimensions, rational frame rate, streams and clean ending match the brief; the editable source and provenance remain available.
